patches.before: When considering cooperation between rice and livestock farmers, distinguish stem-and-leaf volume for WCS from the evaluation criteria other than eating quality and grain traits of feed rice. Then compare ways of limiting production cost relative to the unit selling price. This organization does not prescribe a particular variety, feeding amount or compost application rate.
patches.after: When considering cooperation between rice and livestock farmers, distinguish the emphasis on stem-and-leaf volume for WCS from the emphasis on criteria other than eating quality, together with grain traits, for feed rice. Then compare ways of limiting production cost relative to the unit selling price. This organization does not prescribe a particular variety, feeding amount or compost application rate.
patches.reason: Remove attachment ambiguity that could exclude both eating quality and grain traits; Japanese retains grain traits as part of the feed-rice comparison.

patches.after: स्तर 1 स्रोत बताता है कि गर्मियों में अधिक तापमान होने पर शीतलन उपकरण से ताप घटाया जा सकता है। दूसरी ओर ताप संरक्षण में आवरण आदि से अंदर की गर्मी बनाए रखी जाती है। वेंटिलेशन और शीतलन को गर्मी बनाए रखने वाले आवरण के साथ तापमान एक ही दिशा में बदलने वाले उपाय न मानें।
